newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold prices firm, silver prices recover.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold prices firm, silver prices recover.

text.p: Indian gold prices firmed in early trade on Tuesday while silver recovered after recent losses, dealers said.
Thin supplies and speculative inquiries kept gold prices up but physical buying for the wedding session remained at a low ebb, they said.
Gold was up by five rupees per 10 grams on Monday. Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grams) were steady at 58,700 rupees per piece while it was up by 100 rupees per piece on Monday.
Silver prices were steady in the absence of fresh arrivals and industrial support. It was down by 20 rupees on Monday.
The Bombay bullion market will be closed on Wednesday for Christmas and the market will reopen for trading on Thursday, dealers said.
